content: Meal replacements, such as shakes and bars, are a dietary strategy specifically designed to assist with weight and calorie management. These products provide a predetermined amount of macronutrients, ensuring nutritional consistency while facilitating calorie control. Clinical studies have demonstrated their effectiveness in promoting weight loss and improving glucose management in individuals with diabetes. They are particularly recommended as a structured dietary approach for individuals who require additional support in maintaining dietary consistency and adhering to calorie restrictions.
